contradictions.description: Structural v1 compatibility. The candidate-only-1 production request profile restricts this array to zero items and rejects policy violations.

unresolved.description: Structural v1 compatibility. The candidate-only-1 production request profile restricts this array to zero items and rejects policy violations.

commitment_key.description: Approved source-version anchor key from the snapshot, or null if unresolved. Runtime validation binds identity independently of candidate IDs and quote boundaries.

amount_text.description: Preserve the stated raw amount token verbatim, including invalid or incomplete numeric text. A known usable INR amount has at most two fractional digits; invalid precision is unknown financial value, not a known amount disagreement. Null only if unstated.

date_text.description: Preserve the explicit raw temporal expression verbatim, even when vague or unresolvable (for example next week or later). An unresolved date may coexist with this raw text; deterministic deadline resolution remains unknown. Null only if no temporal expression is stated.

payment_date_text.description: Preserve the explicit raw temporal expression verbatim, even when vague or unresolvable (for example next week or later). An unresolved date may coexist with this raw text; deterministic deadline resolution remains unknown. Null only if no temporal expression is stated.

kind.description: Direct known disagreement: INVOICE_FACT compares active authoritative invoice records; PAYMENT_CLAIM compares a customer claim and active authoritative ledger with the exact same non-null transaction reference; OTHER_CANDIDATE compares active authoritative same-reference ledger records. A reversal is a later settlement lifecycle event, not itself a contradiction of an earlier payment claim; exclude reversal records and their reversed originals from active factual comparisons. No arithmetic-only, different-reference, formatting-equivalent or validly corrected conflicts; unknown values are not known disagreements.

field.description: The exact cited candidate or typed financial source field must be missing, invalid or disputed; a case-wide financial limitation does not make a known source field unknown. ATTRIBUTION means a verified payment-to-anchored-commitment link, cited on that commitment message clause, never missing invoice allocation. Invalid monetary precision is an AMOUNT uncertainty, not known monetary disagreement. Preserve stated raw temporal text even for unresolved dates. Do not invent unknown values. Empty unresolved arrays are allowed when deterministic findings preserve the gaps.
